items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: No, it wasn‟t much. I think it was just rhythm section and guitar.

Yeah, it‟s a small group. Then Shorty Rogers. Then here is Maynard. There‟s not a record title on this. It‟s just showing a date. Blues at Five, and it has you listed in the reed section. So we‟ll just skip over that one. Then The Big Shorty Rogers Express, Shorty Rogers and his orchestra. This one is from July of 1956, and you‟re performing in the group. Not showing any arranging credits on this one. Johnny Richards, Tommy Alexander. Here‟s another Maynard. On this one, it looks like a large group. Ernie…
It must have been one of Maynard‟s own dates.
